critic.summary: Each card turns on its character's voice or facts and couldn't be dealt to anyone else; schedules agree (Kael at the boathouse in the evening). Two continuity fixes about Corvin's last warning, both made.

issues.problem: The narration states that Corvin is one detention from being sent home, a personal fact the player may not know yet.
issues.fix: Show that clause only {knows(corvin.last_warning): …}; his name going in the book stands on its own.

issues.problem: "You know what that means" assumes the player knows his last warning.
issues.fix: Corvin says it outright ("and they send me home"), and every outcome learns corvin.last_warning.
